title: DAY 0: THE SHAKING
lessons: Drop, cover, and hold on during shaking.
On the coast, when the shaking stops, walk to high ground immediately — don't wait for an official warning.
Grab the go-bag, not your belongings.

parts.title: The Ordinary Morning
parts.hook: The lights go out while the shaking keeps going.

scenes.title: Gull Harbor
scenes.action: Establishing shot of rainy Gull Harbor main street (intact): ferry at the dock, calm harbor, storefronts, the hill to the east. Slow push-in with a gentle pan right. The series title 'RAINY DAY' appears large and hand-lettered (League Gothic, slicker yellow, ink outline) at ~1.0s and clears by ~5.4s; 'DAY 0 · THE SHAKING' lands at ~6.0s and clears by ~11.4s. From ~8.6s Drizzle (slicker, hood up) walks in from the left along the sidewalk carrying a paper grocery bag and heads off right (home).
scenes.end: Drizzle exits right; title card clearing.

captions.text: It rains here two hundred days a year.
Drizzle is ready for every one of them.

scenes.title: The Snack Bag
scenes.action: Drizzle's kitchen, rain on the window. Drizzle (slicker on, indoors) potters by the stove; the kettle steams; a mug sits on the table. Mags opens the front door and steps in holding her radio. Banter: she eyes his slicker; says she's here for sugar and to check his go-bag; he points at the go-bag sitting on the bench by the door (RainyDay.goBag prop on the bench handle); she counts contents on her fingers; he defends snacks. Each speaker has talk:true during their line. Ends with both standing near the table, Mags unimpressed, Drizzle grinning.
scenes.start: Drizzle at the stove; door closed.
scenes.end: Drizzle just left of the table, Mags right of the table, both standing.

captions.speaker: DRIZZLE
captions.text: You never know when it'll rain in here.

captions.speaker: MAGS
captions.text: I came for sugar. And to check your go-bag.

captions.speaker: DRIZZLE
captions.text: My snack bag? It's by the door.

captions.speaker: MAGS
captions.text: Water. Flashlight. Meds. Radio. Snacks LAST.

captions.speaker: DRIZZLE
captions.text: Snacks are a food group, Mags.

scenes.title: The Rattle
scenes.action: Same kitchen. The wall clock reads 10:42. The mug on the table starts to rattle and creep; the pendant lamp begins to sway. Drizzle stares at the mug. At ~6.4s strong shaking begins (RainyDay.shake on the scene wrapper, ramping in) and continues to the end. Mags shouts. Drizzle's wrong instinct: he runs toward the front doorway (~9.0s). Mags points at the table. Both DROP, crawl under the table and take COVER (~12-14s), then each grips a table leg and HOLDS ON (holdOn pose) by ~16s; the table jitters; plates on the shelf rattle (fallables jiggle but do not fall yet).
scenes.start: Both standing near the table (as s02 ended).
scenes.end: Both under the table in holdOn, shaking at full strength.

captions.speaker: DRIZZLE
captions.text: Mags... why is my mug dancing?

captions.speaker: MAGS
captions.text: Grab a leg. Hold on. Don't let go.

scenes.title: It Keeps Going
scenes.action: Under the table, shaking at full strength the whole scene (shake from 0, no ramp-in). Closer framing on the table (slow push-in). Things fall around them: plates slide off the shelf and break, the potted plant tips, the picture swings, the lamp swings hard. A small hand-drawn timer card in the upper-left reads 0:45, then 1:30, then 2:40 as the scene progresses (ink on a paper card, in-world). Drizzle peeks out, worried; Mags keeps her head down. At ~16.6s the lamp's soft light cone flickers twice and goes OUT: the scene drops to near-black (night overlay ~92%) with only faint outlines of the table and two pairs of eyes; shaking continues in the dark to the end.
scenes.start: Both under the table in holdOn, shaking.

captions.speaker: MAGS
captions.text: A big one can last minutes. Stay put.
A magnitude 9 can shake for three to five minutes.

captions.speaker: DRIZZLE
captions.text: Is the house supposed to make that noise?

parts.title: The Quiet After
parts.hook: Out past the harbor mouth, the horizon begins to rise.

scenes.title: Silence
scenes.action: Opens near-black and still: the shaking has stopped. Gray daylight from the window slowly returns (night overlay fades from ~92% to 0 over 0-3s), revealing the wrecked kitchen (mess:1) with dust motes hanging in the window light (slow drift). Both still under the table holding on; a beat; Drizzle lets go and crawls out (~7s), stands and looks around (worried). Mags crawls out more slowly and stands, radio in hand, determined.
scenes.start: Both under the table in holdOn, dark.
scenes.end: Both standing in the wrecked kitchen; Mags nearer the door, Drizzle center.

captions.speaker: DRIZZLE
captions.text: Is it over? Can I let go of the table?

captions.speaker: MAGS
captions.text: You can let go. We're not staying.

captions.speaker: MAGS
captions.text: We're on the coast. Shaking that long means one thing.

scenes.title: Go-Bag, Not Stuff
scenes.action: Wrecked kitchen. Drizzle frantically gathers belongings into his arms: a laptop, a photo album, a potted plant — a teetering stack (scene-drawn props carried at his hands via onDraw). Mags points at the stack. He sets the stack on the table (~8s). She points at the go-bag on the bench. He picks it up and swings it onto his back (switch his figure to bag:true at ~10s and hide the bench prop). At ~10.6s a hand-drawn card pops in at upper right with five small ink icons and labels: water, flashlight, radio, meds, sweater. He looks back at the plant; Mags deadpans; they head for the door (right).
scenes.start: Both standing in the wrecked kitchen.
scenes.end: Drizzle wearing the go-bag; both walking toward the door at right.

captions.speaker: DRIZZLE
captions.text: Okay. Okay. Laptop. Photo album. Plant...

captions.speaker: MAGS
captions.text: Put it down. All of it.

scenes.title: The Harbor Leaves
scenes.action: Main street after the quake (damage:1), light rain. Drizzle (go-bag on) and Mags step in from the right side of the frame (coming out of his house) and stop mid-street. A few muted gray neighbors (scene-drawn simple stick figures in mist/steel, no yellow) stand around looking at phones. At ~4s Drizzle notices the harbor at left: over 4-14s the water DRAINS far below normal (animate harbor.setLevel from levelY down to the drained level), exposing mud, the ferry settling and tilting on the bottom, a few fish flopping (tiny ink marks). Drizzle points at it; Mags looks grim. A neighbor holds up a phone (a small fog-colored screen glow).
scenes.end: Harbor drained; Drizzle pointing at it, Mags beside him.

captions.speaker: MAGS
captions.text: Out. And it's coming back. Bigger.
SEA DRAINING AWAY = A TSUNAMI IS COMING

captions.speaker: NEIGHBOR
captions.text: No alert on my phone yet...

scenes.title: Be the Siren
scenes.action: Same street, harbor still drained (start at the drained level). A tall tsunami-siren pole (scene-drawn, steel, horn cluster on top) stands silent — Drizzle looks up at it (lookUp). Mags turns east (right) toward the hill and starts walking. Drizzle cups his hands to his mouth and yells to the neighbors; they look up and start walking uphill (right) one by one. Final ~4s: the camera drifts left toward the open sea past the drained harbor; on the far horizon a thin dark line rises (scene-drawn) — the hook.
scenes.end: Everyone heading right/uphill; a dark line rising on the horizon.

captions.speaker: MAGS
captions.text: Don't wait for a warning. Walk uphill. NOW.
Out past the harbor mouth, the horizon began to rise.

parts.title: Uphill
parts.hook: A gray line across the whole horizon, moving fast.

scenes.title: Walk, Don't Drive
scenes.action: The east end of main street by the gas station: a jam of simple ink-outline cars (scene-drawn, gray) stuck on the cracked road; a driver leans out of a window. Drizzle and Mags walk briskly (walk cycle) left to right past the stalled cars toward the hill. Drizzle waves a driver out of his car; the driver gets out and follows on foot. The camera pans right with them.
scenes.start: Our two enter at left, walking.
scenes.end: Walking off toward the hill at right, a driver following on foot.

captions.speaker: MAGS
captions.text: Roads crack and jam. Feet don't get stuck in traffic.
WALK, DON'T DRIVE — ROADS MAY BE BROKEN OR BLOCKED

captions.speaker: DRIZZLE
captions.text: Leave the car! Walk with us!
The hill was twenty minutes away. On foot.

scenes.title: Aftershock
scenes.action: The evacuation trail through the firs, with the blue-white TSUNAMI EVACUATION ROUTE sign. Drizzle and Mags climb (walk cycle following trailY). At ~7.0s an aftershock hits (shake, medium strength, ~6s): the firs sway, a few small rocks roll down the trail. Both get low on the trail and cover their heads and necks with their arms (cover pose), away from tree trunks. The shaking stops at ~13s; they stand up; Drizzle brushes himself off; they keep climbing.

captions.text: The evacuation trail. Steep. Muddy. Perfect.

captions.speaker: DRIZZLE
captions.text: At least I'm getting my steps in.

captions.speaker: MAGS
captions.text: Down! Cover your head and neck!
NO TABLE? GET LOW. ARMS OVER HEAD AND NECK.

scenes.title: The Radio
scenes.action: Higher on the trail. Mags stops, winded, and sits on a rock by the trail (sit pose); Drizzle comes back and offers his arm (reach). Mags cranks the radio: a small crank handle spins beside it and hand-drawn static squiggles come out (in-world); at ~10s the squiggles turn into neat sound-wave arcs as a voice comes through. She gets up with Drizzle's help and they keep climbing.
scenes.end: Both climbing again, Mags leaning on Drizzle's arm.

captions.speaker: MAGS
captions.text: Give me a second. These knees are old.

captions.speaker: DRIZZLE
captions.text: Lean on me. I'm very sturdy.

captions.speaker: RADIO
captions.text: ...tsunami warning for the Washington coast... move to high ground...

scenes.title: Look Back
scenes.action: A switchback with the wide view down to the drained harbor and the ocean (harbor at the drained level the whole scene). Drizzle stops and turns to look back (facing left toward the view); Mags keeps going, then stops and turns too. On the horizon the waveLine appears at ~6.5s and over the rest of the scene thickens and rises slightly as it advances. Slow push-in toward the horizon over the last 6s. End on the gray line, both figures small on the trail.
scenes.end: Both stopped, looking at the advancing gray line.

captions.text: A gray line stretched across the whole horizon.

parts.title: The Hilltop
parts.hook: Gull Harbor is cut off, and there's a light out on the water.

scenes.title: The Wave
scenes.action: Same view. The wave arrives: the waveLine sweeps in and the harbor SURGES far above normal (harbor.setLevel from drained to surged over ~3-12s): the dock and the ferry disappear under gray water and water pushes into the lowland streets (environment only, no people visible). Drizzle and Mags run up the last switchback (run cycle along trailY), Drizzle pulling Mags by the hand; they reach the top edge and exit right.
scenes.start: Both on the switchback looking back.
scenes.end: Both run off the top right of the trail; harbor flooded.

captions.text: The first wave hit 22 minutes after the shaking.
THE FIRST WAVE IS OFTEN NOT THE BIGGEST

scenes.title: Assembly Area
scenes.action: The hilltop assembly area, rain easing. Drizzle and Mags stagger in from the left; Drizzle drops to sit on the ground (sit, relieved grin); Mags stands beside him, radio in hand. Ms. Ortega's class (a row of small gray stick-figure kids with their teacher, scene-drawn and/or the crowd group) sits under the canopy; one kid waves at Drizzle and he waves back. At far right, the flooded lowland (view.setLevel high).
scenes.end: Drizzle sitting, Mags standing beside him; kids under the canopy.

captions.text: The hilltop assembly area. Higher than any wave.

captions.speaker: DRIZZLE
captions.text: We made it. We actually made it.

captions.speaker: MAGS
captions.text: Because we didn't wait. Remember that.
The school got every kid up the hill. They'd practiced.

scenes.title: Three Things
scenes.action: Closer two-shot on the hilltop. Drizzle counts on his fingers (point/talk); three hand-drawn index cards pin up one by one on the canopy pole beside them (ink on paper, each with a tiny doodle: a table, an uphill arrow, a backpack) on the caption cues (~3.8s, ~7.0s, ~10.2s). Then Drizzle pulls a granola bar out of the go-bag (the bag stays on; the bar is a small prop at his hand) and offers it to Mags; she takes it, deadpan.
scenes.end: Drizzle standing, offering the snack; Mags holding it.

captions.text: 3 · GRAB THE GO-BAG, NOT YOUR STUFF

scenes.title: Cut Off
scenes.action: Dusk on the hilltop (a night overlay deepening from 0 to ~55% across the scene). Mags cranks the radio; sound-wave arcs come out. Drizzle walks to the edge and looks out over the flooded lowland at right. At ~13.4s a pulsing bright paper-white light appears out on the dark water (a distress flare), with a soft fog-colored glow ring. Final ~2s: a 'NEXT: DAY 1' hand-lettered sting (League Gothic, slicker yellow) appears center-right and holds.
scenes.end: Drizzle at the edge staring at the light on the water; NEXT: DAY 1 card.

captions.speaker: RADIO
captions.text: ...the Highway 101 bridge at Gull Creek has collapsed...
Then — a light on the water.
